lines.text: Many learners say: I gave the exam yesterday.
Better: I took the exam yesterday.
You take an exam. Teachers give it.
Take! I will take an exam next week.

data.why: You take an exam. Teachers give it.

quiz.stem: I will ___ an exam next week.

native.tip: Türkçede “sınav vermek” deriz ama İngilizcede sınava “take” ile girilir.
native.caption: “I gave the exam yesterday” mi diyorsun? 🙈 İngilizcede sınavı öğrenci “take” eder, öğretmen “give” eder. Doğrusu “I took the exam yesterday”. Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasında daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “take”. Sınava giren kişi take der. Ücretsiz testle pratik yap: {link}

en.tip: In Turkish you “give” an exam, but in English you “take” it.
en.caption: Do you say “I gave the exam yesterday”? 🙈 In English the student takes an exam, and the teacher gives it. The right sentence is “I took the exam yesterday”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
